0.0.n: A noun linked to もの by の to describe the thing someone wishes for.

0.1.n: Links 望み to もの; together they describe a desired thing.

0.2.n: Refers broadly to whatever the listener desires.

0.3.n: With 欲しい, が marks what someone wants, rather than who wants it.

0.4.n: An adjective expressing desire for something; the listener is understood as the person wanting it.

0.5.n: Makes this a direct question; the plain form gives it a forceful tone.

1.0.n: Points to the listener’s wish and must come before a noun.

1.1.n: Names what will be granted in the next line; the usual object marker を is omitted.

2.0.n: Means the nation's people; here it forms part of the name 国民クイズ, National Quiz.

2.1.n: An English loanword forming the second part of the name 国民クイズ.

2.2.n: Identifies 国民クイズ as the one carrying out the action.

2.3.n: 叶える in て-form plus やろう declares an intention to do someone a favor, with a commanding, potentially condescending tone.

3.0.n: Forms the first part of the name 国民クイズ, repeated here as an announcement.

3.1.n: Completes the name 国民クイズ; the exclamation gives the title an emphatic delivery.

0.lit: Do you want the thing of your desire?
0.tip: 欲しい uses が to mark the thing wanted; the person wanting it is left unstated.

1.tip: This phrase carries over into the next line as the thing being granted.

2.lit: National Quiz shall grant it for you!
2.tip: てやろう presents the action as a favor the speaker intends to perform, often sounding assertive or superior.

3.tip: This is a standalone title announcement, so no verb or particle is needed.
